metadata.description: Curated real-world benchmark dataset for internal telemetry traffic. Replaces synthetic random generation with trimmed, real system call execution traces and authentic clinical timeseries records.

sources.name: ADFA-LD (Australian Defence Force Academy Linux Dataset)
sources.institution: University of New South Wales (UNSW Canberra)
sources.citation: Creech, G., & Hu, J. (2013). Generation of a new Australian Defence Force Academy Linux Dataset (ADFA-LD). IEEE WiMob 2013.
sources.role: Host-level system call traces, token sequences, and binary execution provenance.

sources.name: MIMIC-III Clinical Database
sources.institution: MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology & Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
sources.authors: Alistair E.W. Johnson, Tom J. Pollard, Lu Shen, et al.
sources.citation: Johnson, A. E. W. et al. (2016). MIMIC-III, a freely accessible critical care database. Scientific Data 3:160035.
sources.role: Real ICU patient telemetry (heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2), authentic medication formulary (NDC codes), and ICD-10 claims.
